verdict.rationale: Stable documents free high-res scans of the internal contents of mail, so it goes beyond envelope photos. Keyword-based auto-routing on text inside mail and AI summaries of contents imply the scans are text-extracted. However, no evidence states a scan turnaround time or confirms the output is searchable PDFs. Missing for 10: stated same/next-business-day scan turnaround, explicit searchable-PDF/OCR output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
